test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Prakash and Avinash can complete a work in 24 days. If Prakash alone can complete it in 48 days, then in how many days can Avinash alone complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Prakash and Avinash can complete a work in 24 days.

Prakash alone can complete it in 48 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work completed by Prakash and Avinash in one day = 1/24

Work completed by Prakash in one day = 1/48

Work completed by Avinash in one day = Work completed by both in one day - Work completed by Prakash in one day</p
